comment: Known CI flake signatures, matched against the failure text of every failing
test in the pytest-html artifact. A test matches a signature when every
string in `all_of` appears in its failure text; a run is `matches_known_flake`
only when *every* failing test matches one, and `unrelated_to_known_flake` as
Match the signature, never the test name, because a flake's victim rotates.
The one signature shipped below is an example from one project's test suite,
not a signature every project needs: there, three tests dial example.com and
leave an httpx socket unclosed, the resulting ResourceWarning becomes a
PytestUnraisableExceptionWarning, and that fails whichever unrelated test
happened to be running under filterwarnings = error. A test-name allowlist
would have been wrong on its first run.
This file is data. Replace the signatures with your own project's, and extend
it when a new flake appears. A hint is never a gate: a red build is reported
whatever its cause, because both causes are work.
